snippet.title: NBA 2K10 - PS3 2009 (2009-10 Season 10-27-2009 POR vs HOU)
snippet.description:
Hey guys what is up I am doing a Season on the NBA on NBA 2K10 for the PS3 
This is a game between the Houston Rockets and the Portland Trail Blazers. 
I am doing this season because there's no live sports around the world since this pandemic is on going so might as well do old school NBA games in the video game form so enjoy some simulation on Basketball.

NBA 2K10 is raising the bar again with another Championship season.
